parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
The node type. Valid values:

*   qrs: Query Result Searcher (QRS) worker
*   search: Search worker
*   index: index
*   cluster: cluster

example.unifiedCli: aliyun searchengine get-node-config --instance-id ha-cn-pl32rf00000 --type index --name ha-cn-30174dhoz53_qrs --cluster-name vpc_sh_domain_2 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun searchengine GET /openapi/ha3/instances/ha-cn-pl32rf00000/node-config --region cn-hangzhou --clusterName vpc_sh_domain_2 --name 'ha-cn-30174dhoz53_qrs' --type index --header "Content-Type=application/json"
